* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 18 June 2023<ref name="ht-781a0de">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual21-Dark/large/zuckussand4lominmisthunter.gif</code> as published 18 June 2023: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/781a0de1bab57c271fca72a4887b826bb1a30838/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Dark/large/zuckussand4lominmisthunter.gif holotable commit 781a0de] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilots are •Zuckuss, who provides ability of 4, and •4-LOM. Players may not add power destinies or draw more than one battle destiny here. Immune to attrition &lt; 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Zuckuss And 4-LOM In Mist Hunter (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 4, file created 17 June 2023: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilots are •Zuckuss, who provides ability of 4, and •4-LOM. Players may not add power destinies or draw more than one battle destiny here. Immune to attrition &lt; 5.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Zuckuss And 4-LOM In Mist Hunter]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Zuckuss And 4-LOM In Mist Hunter]] (published 18 June 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Zuckuss And 4-LOM In Mist Hunter”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Mist Hunter]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
